attributes.storage_instructions: Store Asomex AT 2.5 mg tablets at room temperature in a cool and dry place, away from sunlight. Keep the tablets out of reach of children and pets. Store the medicine in its original packaging. If it is past the expiry date, do not take the medicine and dispose of it with biomedical waste.
